name: Larktale Coast

clekListed.clekRow: Larktale Coast — Car Seat Adapter – Multi-Model (LK29400)

specs._weightNote: Larktale publishes 21.2 lb; BabyGearLab measured 20.9 lb.

brake.type: single-action foot pedal parking brake (press to set / press to release)

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (reclines near-flat; car-seat/bassinet ready) to ~4 yr / 55 lb

safety.standards: US federal stroller standard 16 CFR 1227 / ASTM F833
safety.certifications: Not confirmed in retrieved sources (JPMA status unverified — larktale.com unreachable).
safety.notes: 5-point rethread harness; UPF 50+ canopy with peek-a-boo window; lockable front swivel wheels; all-wheel suspension. Award-winning design (Good Design). Car-seat click-in compatible with Chicco/Britax/Maxi-Cosi/Clek/Nuna via adapter.

specs.recline: multi-position reclining backrest, near-flat for napping
specs.tires: foam-filled plastic wheels; front swivel (lockable) with all-wheel suspension

notes: Full-size compact stroller; weighs 21.2 lb with an ultra-compact Compac3 3D self-nesting fold (23.6 × 13.2 × 26.2 in). Newborn to ~55 lb. On Clek's official Liing/Liingo list, paired with the Larktale 'Car Seat Adapter – Multi-Model' LK29400 (adapter-lk29400), which lists the Clek Liing. GAP: unfolded dimensions unpublished (null); Larktale's DTC site (larktale.com) 404s/blocks scrapers and the brand has shifted to wagons, so the Coast stroller appears discontinued at DTC — best live price is the Amazon listing (~$269.99; BabyGearLab cites $300 list). Verify stock/price at checkout.
